title: NYC Gets 1,918 Noise Calls Every Day
hook: NYC receives 1,918 noise complaints every day.
closing: Constant complaints show how sharply noise affects daily city life.
question: What noise bothers you most?

segments.say: Noise makes up 18% of NYC complaints. It is one of the city's biggest daily frustrations.
NYC noise complaints reached 700,000. Residents are reporting far more disruption.
NYC averages 1,918 noise calls daily. The complaint line rarely gets a quiet moment.
